C0481.title: NPC Deputy Proposes Mandatory Facial Recognition Login for Adult Gamers
C0481.summary: During the 2022 Two Sessions, CPPCC National Committee member Yu Xinwei highlighted that many minors still bypass anti-addiction systems through identity fraud. Reasons include children tricking parents into facial scans under the guise of studying, and illegal groups renting accounts or offering proxy facial recognition services.
